text:
jess: Quick sync — need to promote billing-service to prod EU tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Chart bump v2.4.0 -> v2.5.0. Mostly config + a small index migration. Asking for a promotion-exemption from the default 1h canary; canary runs the migration twice and causes short lock pressure.

omar: Why skip the canary instead of fixing migration to be harmless?

jess: Migration is idempotent but adds ~8s per pod and we saw transient DB lock spikes in staging when run twice. Ops suggested a staggered rollout instead of full canary.

marta: If we skip the canary we need a clear rollback playbook, and annotate the release so it’s easy to find later. Also add a health gate in values.

jess: Proposed plan:
- helm upgrade --install billing --namespace prod --reuse-values \n  --set image.tag=2.5.0 \n  --set rollout.staggerSeconds=30 \n  --set migrations.run_once=true
- schedule 02:00 UTC maintenance window (EU)
- add release annotation: release/handback=jess/gradual-promo

liam: Window works for infra. Oncall will watch. Add release note text: "Add index on invoices.created_at to reduce join latency"

release-bot: Promotion request received from @jess for billing v2.5.0. Scheduled time 1739200800 (tomorrow 02:00 UTC). Automated checks: image-scan=pass, chart-lint=pass, preflight-migration-duration=warn (>5s). Manual approval required.

marta: I approve conditionally: abort/rollback if error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR if DB locks exceed threshold. Set alert: billing.errors.rate > 0.5% and billing.db.lock_time > 200ms.

jess: Added Grafana alerts and a short smoke test to run after promotion. Smoke test: `curl -f https://billing.prod.example/healthz` and a sample invoice create.

liam: Rollback command noted for oncall: `helm rollback billing 1 --namespace prod` — keep the previous release pinned as release 1. Release-notes PR: #456 (will include rollback steps & contacts).

omar: Please ensure values.yaml has `debug=false` and readinessProbe.path=/healthz. Also include a short postdeploy hook that sleeps 10s before running post-migration checks.

jess: I’ll open the release-notes PR now and push a short playbook into the runbook repo with the rollback steps, emergency contacts, and the metric thresholds. Thanks all.
